_comment: PaperHub downloads use GET /paperhub/paperdownload?id=ES_ID with SCHOLARSEED_API_KEY from the environment.
PAPERHUB_URL overrides the PaperHub base or endpoint; PAPER_HUB_URL remains a legacy download override.
Text/image credentials and endpoints remain independently configured.
Paper-card upload is a separate legacy service; changing downloads does not authorize or redirect uploads.

upload_base.description: Paper-card upload target; set UPLOAD_BASE_URL explicitly before uploading
